title: A database for a small B2B SaaS
variant: Tight and numeric, the winner as a one-line result strip
prompt: Choose a database for a small B2B SaaS: Postgres, MySQL, MongoDB, or SQLite with Litestream.
note: Tight and numeric, on a narrow measure with small margins, because an engineer reads this in a pull request tab: the winner is a one-line mono result strip under the title rather than a card, weights are a bare three-column table with no bars, and the scorecard encodes 1 to 5 scores as small dots with the winning column tinted and the raw points and the totals as mono rows under it. A named 'why not the runner-up' paragraph and a 'never wins' line do the sensitivity work in prose, and there is no interaction and no photo.
